name: p6g8-formrow-overlap
description: spawn form: working-directory FormRow must shrink inside its flex row instead of overflowing (kata p6g8)

mutation.note: Re-verified after the case picked up styles/global.css (kata e4sh). The reset global.css brings widened .cfgDir 370 -> 383px, and the cwd string then fit inside it with 3.6px to spare - the mutation had stopped failing, so layoutguard's flagship case was no longer detecting a deleted min-width:0. Fixed by narrowing the fixture's COLUMN, not by lengthening its string: .page went 1116px -> 640px. Above ~750px the width was inert anyway, because spawn.module.css's own .form max-width:720px capped the row first; 640px gives a 606px content box, below that cap so the column is tight and above the 559px container breakpoint so the Start button's word collapse is not dragged in. The cwd is back to the plain repo root, the commonest real value. Measured at 640px: unmutated fits with 44.0px to spare, mutated overflows by 110.4px, row stays unwrapped (sameVerticalBand true, overlapX -238). Do not narrow past ~600px, where the row wraps and the branch-vs-effort assertion stops meaning anything.
